sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Osorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·奥索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分访谈进行现场直播，11月18日，任何人都可以访问 nytimes.com

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费权限，畅享我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Kevin Roos, in for Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是凯文·罗斯，代班迈克尔·巴巴罗，《纽约时报》出品。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For more than a year, questionable claims that a drug called ivermectin is effective at treating the coronavirus have run rampant online and across right-wing media.
sentences.zh: 一年多来，关于一种名为伊维菌素的药物对治疗冠状病毒有效的可疑言论，在网络和右翼媒体上大肆泛滥。

sentences.en: But even as the medical establishment rejects these claims, demand for ivermectin has skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 但即便医学界拒绝接受这些说法，对伊维菌素的需求却激增。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague Emma Goldberg about how this little-known drug that's widely used to treat livestock
sentences.zh: 我与同事埃玛·戈德堡谈论了这种原本广泛用于治疗牲畜的鲜为人知的药物，

sentences.en: became the COVID treatment of choice for many Americans reluctant to take the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 是如何成为许多不愿接种疫苗的美国人首选的 COVID 治疗药物的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 4th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月4日，星期一。

sentences.en: Emma, full disclosure, I've been basically begging The Daily team to let me do an episode on the ivermectin story for months now.
sentences.zh: 埃玛，坦白说，几个月来我基本一直在恳求《每日新闻》团队让我做一期关于伊维菌素故事的节目。

sentences.en: And I'm so interested in this story because, like, A, it's a story about people doing weird stuff on the internet, which is sort of my wheelhouse.
sentences.zh: 我之所以对这个故事如此感兴趣，是因为，A，这是一个关于人们在互联网上做怪事的故事，这可以说是我的专长。

sentences.en: And B, it seems to be this, like, strangely durable story.
sentences.zh: B，这似乎是一个，呃，出奇地持久的故事。

sentences.en: Like, I thought that people would sort of stop talking about ivermectin, like they stopped talking about other COVID miracle treatments.
sentences.zh: 就像，我以为人们会停止谈论伊维菌素，就像他们停止谈论其他 COVID 奇迹疗法一样。

sentences.en: But it seems like ivermectin is still very present.
sentences.zh: 但伊维菌素似乎依然随处可见。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it certainly hasn't gone away.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，它当然没有消失。

sentences.en: I've been talking with doctors in recent weeks who told me that every day they have patients begging them for ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 我最近几周一直在和医生交谈，他们告诉我，每天都有患者恳求他们开伊维菌素。

sentences.en: I've been talking with people at poison control centers who said they've been getting way more than the usual number of calls from people overdosing on ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 我一直在和毒物控制中心的人交谈，他们说他们接到因服用过量伊维菌素而拨打的求助电话数量，远超平时。

sentences.en: And recently, we're seeing reporting that veterinarians are, in some cases, having trouble accessing ivermectin because people are taking the livestock version.
sentences.zh: 最近，我们看到有报道称，由于人们在服用牲畜版的药物，兽医在某些情况下很难买到伊维菌素。

sentences.en: The frenzy has continued to build, and it strangely hasn't gone away, even as public health officials are begging people not to take the drug.
sentences.zh: 这种狂热仍在不断升级，而且出奇地没有消失，尽管公共卫生官员一直在恳求人们不要服用这种药。

sentences.en: So, just to back up, what is ivermectin?
sentences.zh: 那么，退一步说，什么是伊维菌素？

sentences.en: Ivermectin is an antiparasitic.
sentences.zh: 伊维菌素是一种抗寄生虫药。

sentences.en: It emerged in the 1970s mostly to deworm animals.
sentences.zh: 它于20世纪70年代问世，主要用于为动物驱虫。

sentences.en: It's given to horses and other livestock.
sentences.zh: 它被用于马和其他牲畜。

sentences.en: Then, later, scientists found that it could also be used for humans to treat things like scabies, lice, river blindness.
sentences.zh: 后来，科学家发现它也可以用于人类，治疗疥疮、虱子、河盲症等疾病。

sentences.en: And the scientists who made that discovery actually won a Nobel Prize for their work in 2015.
sentences.zh: 而做出这一发现的科学家因其在2015年的工作而荣获了诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: And how did ivermectin get tangled up in the discussion about COVID treatments?
sentences.zh: 那么伊维菌素是如何卷入关于 COVID 治疗的讨论中的呢？

sentences.en: So, it really started early on in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以，这其实始于大流行初期。

sentences.en: And this was before the days when we had vaccines, when doctors were really desperate for anything that might offer a potential cure for patients with COVID.
sentences.zh: 那是在我们拥有疫苗之前的日子，当时医生们真的迫切需要任何可能为 COVID 患者提供潜在治愈方法的方案。

sentences.en: This was a time when the hospitals were overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 那是一个医院人满为患的时期。

sentences.en: People just did not know how to confront this novel disease.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不知道如何应对这种新型疾病。

sentences.en: And they were sort of throwing a lot of different things at the wall to see what stuck.
sentences.zh: 他们只是把很多不同的方法都拿来试试，看哪个管用。

sentences.en: And that was when you got some people latching on to ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，有些人开始迷恋上伊维菌素。

sentences.en: And you got some doctors and scientists starting to ask, well, is there a possibility that we can give this to human patients
sentences.zh: 一些医生和科学家开始发问，那么，我们有没有可能把它给人类患者服用，

sentences.en: and it can prevent them from either getting COVID in the first place or from experiencing the worst possible conditions of the disease?
sentences.zh: 从而防止他们一开始感染 COVID，或者防止他们经历该疾病最恶劣的状况？

sentences.en: And what is making people think that ivermectin might actually be effective against COVID?
sentences.zh: 是什么让人们认为伊维菌素实际上可能对 COVID 有效？

sentences.en: So, there was an early study, and that was in spring 2020 in Australia, that showed in vitro, meaning in a lab, not on human patients, that ivermectin could potentially prevent
sentences.zh: 所以，早期有一项研究，那是2020年春天在澳大利亚进行的，它在体外（即在实验室里，而不是在人类患者身上）显示，伊维菌素有可能阻止

sentences.en: coronavirus from replicating.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒复制。

sentences.en: The problem was scientists and doctors were hesitant to extrapolate anything from that because they thought you would probably have to give ivermectin at such high doses
sentences.zh: 问题是科学家和医生对从中引申出任何结论持谨慎态度，因为他们认为你可能必须以极高的剂量服用伊维菌素，

sentences.en: that it would be extremely risky.
sentences.zh: 那将极其危险。

sentences.en: So, they said, sure, this study looks like it could be promising in a test tube, but we don't know that we can take that much from it in terms of what could be useful for humans.
sentences.zh: 因此他们说，当然，这项研究看起来在试管中很有前景，但我们不知道在对人类有用这一点上，我们能从中得出多少结论。

sentences.en: So, it sounds like this study about ivermectin was somewhat hopeful, but limited.
sentences.zh: 听起来这项关于伊维菌素的研究虽然有些希望，但很局限。

sentences.en: And based on these limitations, it doesn't sound like this is going to be this silver bullet for controlling the spread of COVID.
sentences.zh: 基于这些局限性，听起来它不会成为控制 COVID 传播的灵丹妙药。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At this point, we still don't really know what happens when we give ivermectin to humans for COVID.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们仍然不清楚将伊维菌素用于人类治疗 COVID 时会发生什么。

sentences.en: But that doesn't stop doctors around the world in India and Egypt and South Africa from just starting to give it to COVID patients anyway to see what happened.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止世界各地的医生（在印度、埃及和南非）开始将它给 COVID 患者服用，只是为了看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: Again, this was a moment when people were desperate.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是一个人们绝望的时刻。

sentences.en: You saw people, especially in settings like prisons where there were big outbreaks, just trying out ivermectin because it was cheap and readily available.
sentences.zh: 你看到人们，尤其是在爆发大疫情的监狱等环境中，只是在尝试伊维菌素，因为它便宜且容易买到。

sentences.en: And they thought maybe it could be a miracle cure.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这可能是个奇迹般的解药。

sentences.en: So, then you hit November 2020.
sentences.zh: 然后到了2020年11月。

sentences.en: And there's a major study out of Cairo that looked at ivermectin in humans instead of just in cell culture in a lab.
sentences.zh: 开罗有一项重大研究，研究了人类身上的伊维菌素，而不仅仅是实验室的细胞培养物。

sentences.en: And it showed, like that earlier study, that ivermectin could potentially be useful in treating COVID.
sentences.zh: 它和早期的研究一样显示，伊维菌素可能对治疗 COVID 有用。

sentences.en: That seems like a pretty big deal, like a study that claims to show that this drug ivermectin could actually save lives and help people during this huge surge in the virus.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一件相当大的事，就像一项研究声称表明这种药物伊维菌素实际上可以挽救生命并在病毒大爆发期间帮助人们。

sentences.en: So, why wasn't this bigger news?
sentences.zh: 那为什么这不是个更大的新闻？

sentences.en: Why didn't I hear about this last winter?
sentences.zh: 为什么我去年冬天没有听说过这个？

sentences.en: Well, at the time, ivermectin was really still sort of a fringe thing, especially in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时，伊维菌素实际上仍然算是一种边缘事物，尤其是在美国。

sentences.en: You had the one Cairo study, but doctors were waiting for more information, more data, more clinical trials that were high quality.
sentences.zh: 你有一项开罗的研究，但医生们在等待更多信息、更多数据、更多高质量的临床试验。

sentences.en: And a lot of the public attention in the country was focused on the vaccines.
sentences.zh: 该国的大部分公众注意力都集中在疫苗上。

sentences.en: They were about to start rolling out to healthcare workers in December.
sentences.zh: 它们将于12月开始向医护人员推出。

sentences.en: But around that same time, ivermectin does start to gain more of a foothold in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但大约在同一时间，伊维菌素确实开始在美国站稳脚跟。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, it really starts in December 2020.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它确实始于2020年12月。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: This hearing is called to order.
sentences.zh: 现在开会。

sentences.en: Let me start by thanking our witnesses.
sentences.zh: 首先我要感谢我们的证人。

sentences.en: When Republican Senator Ron Johnson from Wisconsin chairs the Senate panel.
sentences.zh: 当来自威斯康星州的共和党参议员罗恩·约翰逊主持参议院小组会议时。

sentences.en: Why is there such a concerted effort to silence the voices of courageous health professionals promoting early treatment?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有如此协调一致的努力来压制宣传早期治疗的勇敢卫生专业人员的声音？

sentences.en: It makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 这毫无道理。

sentences.en: Where he basically accuses the government of ignoring alternative cures to COVID.
sentences.zh: 他基本上指责政府忽视了 COVID 的替代疗法。

sentences.en: Our next witness is here in person, Dr. Pierre Corey.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一位证人就在现场，皮埃尔·科里博士。

sentences.en: And he gets this pulmonary care specialist named Dr. Pierre Corey.
sentences.zh: 他请来了一位名叫皮埃尔·科里博士的肺部护理专家。

sentences.en: Senator, thank you.
sentences.zh: 参议员，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And thank you for holding this hearing.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你召开这次听证会。

sentences.en: To testify about a wonder drug.
sentences.zh: 来证明一种奇迹药物。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about that we have a solution to this crisis.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我们有解决这场危机的方法。

sentences.en: There is a drug that is proving to be of miraculous impact.
sentences.zh: 有一种药物被证明具有奇迹般的效果。

sentences.en: And when I say that, Dr. Corey says, is spectacularly effective at treating COVID patients.
sentences.zh: 当我这么说时，科里博士说，在治疗 COVID 患者方面极其有效。

sentences.en: And that's ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 那就是伊维菌素。

sentences.en: Ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 伊维菌素。

sentences.en: It basically obliterates transmission of this virus.
sentences.zh: 它基本上消灭了这种病毒的传播。

sentences.en: And who is Dr. Corey?
sentences.zh: 科里博士是谁？

sentences.en: Like, what are his qualifications to talk about this?
sentences.zh: 比如说，他有什么资格谈论这个？

sentences.en: Well, because he's a pulmonary care doctor, he's already treated hundreds of COVID patients, including giving a lot of them ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为他是一名肺病科医生，他已经治疗了数百名 COVID 患者，包括给他们中的许多人使用伊维菌素。

sentences.en: He's also part of this controversial group called the
sentences.zh: 他也是一个颇具争议的组织的一员，名为

sentences.en: Frontline COVID-19 Critical Care Alliance that was formed really early on in the pandemic as a network of doctors looking at alternative cures for COVID.
sentences.zh: 前线 COVID-19 临终关怀联盟，该联盟在大流行初期就成立了，作为一个寻找 COVID 替代疗法的医生网络。

sentences.en: At first, they were really focused on steroids.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们真正关注的是类固醇。

sentences.en: And then they switched over to promoting ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 然后他们转向推广伊维菌素。

sentences.en: And they were really out there on the ivermectin cheerleading.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在大力为伊维菌素摇旗呐喊。

sentences.en: They were saying that even people who didn't have COVID should be taking it twice a week just to prevent catching COVID if it was circulating in their community.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至表示，即使是没有感染 COVID 的人也应该每周服用两次，以防止在病毒在社区传播时感染 COVID。

sentences.en: So they were really just kind of advocating it for the general population beyond any kind of evidence that was out there about what it did to treat COVID.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们实际上是在超越关于它如何治疗 COVID 的任何现有证据，向广大民众大力推荐它。

sentences.en: Questions for the record?
sentences.zh: 有要记入记录的问题吗？

sentences.en: This hearing is adjourned.
sentences.zh: 本次听证会休会。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So what was the response to this Senate testimony?
sentences.zh: 那么对这次参议院听证会有何反应？

sentences.en: Well, the medical community was pretty frustrated with it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，医学界对此感到相当沮丧。

sentences.en: And they saw it as an effort to elevate medical misinformation about an unproven drug.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一种抬高关于一种未经证实药物的医学错误信息的努力。

sentences.en: But online, clips from the hearing started to generate a lot of buzz.
sentences.zh: 但在网络上，听证会的片段开始引起热议。

sentences.en: There is over a million views on YouTube.
sentences.zh: YouTube 上的观看次数超过了一百万。

sentences.en: And again, you have to remember, this was a point when most Americans couldn't get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 再次提醒，你必须记住，这是大多数美国人无法接种疫苗的时期。

sentences.en: And hearing that there was a miracle cure for COVID gave people hope.
sentences.zh: 听说有一种针对 COVID 的奇迹疗法给了人们希望。

sentences.en: People wanted to hear that.
sentences.zh: 人们希望听到这个。

sentences.en: But it hadn't really begun to reach the fever pitch that was still coming.
sentences.zh: 但它还没有真正达到即将来临的狂热高潮。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载

sentences.en: Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Emma, you've explained why ivermectin became one of the drugs that people talked about as a potential cure or treatment for COVID.
sentences.zh: 所以埃玛，你已经解释了为什么伊维菌素会成为人们讨论的作为 COVID 潜在治疗方法或药物之一的原因。

sentences.en: But that's not where the story ends, because ivermectin has now become this sort of politically charged lightning rod.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是故事的结束，因为伊维菌素现在已经成为这种具有政治色彩的引爆点。

sentences.en: So how did that happen?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So now we've got to fast forward to spring 2021.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们要快进到2021年春天。

sentences.en: Coronavirus vaccination drive reached a major milestone this week.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒疫苗接种运动本周达到了一个重要里程碑。

sentences.en: Everyone...
sentences.zh: 每个人……

sentences.en: It's starting to look like things are on the up and up.
sentences.zh: 情况开始看起来蒸蒸日上。

sentences.en: Every day here, basically, vaccinations have been going up.
sentences.zh: 这里的疫苗接种量基本上每天都在上升。

sentences.en: And this is a moment when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美国

sentences.en: is still making a big push to roll out the vaccines.
sentences.zh: 仍在大力推行疫苗接种的时期。

sentences.en: It's now accessible to any American adult who will take it.
sentences.zh: 任何愿意接受的美国成年人现在都可以获得它。

sentences.en: Train by day, Joe Rogan podcast by night.
sentences.zh: 白天训练，晚上乔·罗根播客。

sentences.en: And then you have Joe Rogan.
sentences.zh: 然后你有了乔·罗根。

sentences.en: You know, I tried to send a friend of mine a video the other day on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我前几天尝试在推特上给我的朋友发一段视频。

sentences.en: The massively popular podcaster.
sentences.zh: 那个拥有大量粉丝的播客主。

sentences.en: And it was a doctor who was talking about ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 那是一个谈论伊维菌素的医生。

sentences.en: Starting to mention ivermectin on his podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 开始在他的播客上提及伊维菌素。

sentences.en: And this doctor was saying that ivermectin is 99% effective in treating COVID, but that you don't hear about it because you...
sentences.zh: 这位医生说伊维菌素在治疗 COVID 方面有99%的有效率，但你听不到是因为你……

sentences.en: And then in June...
sentences.zh: 然后在6月……

sentences.en: Conversations.
sentences.zh: 对话。

sentences.en: First of all, Dr. Corey, please explain who you are and introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 首先，科里博士，请解释你是谁并做个自我介绍。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So I'm a lung and ICU specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是肺科和 ICU 专家。

sentences.en: He brings on Dr. Corey, who testified about ivermectin in the Senate back in December, along with podcaster Brett Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 他请来了科里博士，他曾在12月在参议院就伊维菌素作证，还有播客主布雷特·韦恩斯坦。

sentences.en: I'm a biologiSt. I'm an evolutionary biologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是一名生物学家。我是一名进化生物学家。

sentences.en: And these two go long on ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 这两个人大力推崇伊维菌素。

sentences.en: My dream is that every household has ivermectin in the cupboard.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是每个家庭的橱柜里都有伊维菌素。

sentences.en: And they suggest that there's a big, grand conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 他们暗示这里有一个巨大的宏伟阴谋。

sentences.en: Objective.
sentences.zh: 客观事实。

sentences.en: Their objective is to not have ivermectin adopted worldwide.
sentences.zh: 他们的目的是不让伊维菌素在全球范围内得到采用。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons they think that there's been so much resistance to it is that they say that ivermectin doesn't have a patent on it.
sentences.zh: 他们认为人们对该药产生如此大抵触的原因之一，是伊维菌素没有专利权。

sentences.en: So people aren't going to make a lot of money on it.
sentences.zh: 所以人们无法从中赚取巨额利润。

sentences.en: Anthony Fauci gave a press conference about a $3 billion initiative to find drugs that work against COVID.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·福奇召开了一场新闻发布会，宣布了一项耗资 30 亿美元的计划，用于寻找治疗新冠有效的药物。

sentences.en: Now, of course, these drugs that they find will all be under patent and therefore highly profitable.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们找到的这些药物都将申请专利，因此会带来巨额利润。

sentences.en: And strangely, we are ignoring the evidence that is right in front of us that we have multiple drugs that are highly effective for COVID.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我们却对眼前的证据视而不见，明明有多种对新冠高度有效的药物。

sentences.en: Which is why they think that the pharmaceutical industry has this elaborate conspiracy to block people from getting it so that they'll just take the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他们认为制药行业有一个精心策划的阴谋，旨在阻止人们获取该药，以便让他们只去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And the two of them paint this picture about the media stopping people from getting information about this miracle COVID drug.
sentences.zh: 他们两人描绘了一幅这样的画卷：媒体阻止人们获取关于这种新冠特效药的信息。

sentences.en: YouTube is playing this weird role, right?
sentences.zh: YouTube 扮演着一个奇怪的角色，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm free.
sentences.zh: 我很自由。

sentences.en: I can talk about scientific evidence.
sentences.zh: 我可以谈论科学证据。

sentences.en: But in order to talk about it with my audience, I have to go through YouTube, right?
sentences.zh: 但为了与我的受众谈论此事，我必须通过 YouTube，对吧？

sentences.en: So YouTube is playing.
sentences.zh: 所以 YouTube 正在扮演……

sentences.en: They're talking about how YouTube is taking down their videos that talk about ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 他们在谈论 YouTube 是如何删除谈论伊维菌素的视频的。

sentences.en: So it's not clear what they are doing or why.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他们在做什么，也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: But it is clear that they don't want certain things discussed.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，他们不希望某些事情被讨论。

sentences.en: I think I remember this moment because I had heard about ivermectin either from Joe Rogan or someone who listened to Joe Rogan.
sentences.zh: 我想我记得这一刻，因为我要么是从乔·罗根那里，要么是从听乔·罗根节目的人那里听说过伊维菌素。

sentences.en: And I remember that the conversation was not so much about the medication and the effectiveness of the medication.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时的对话重点其实不在于药物本身及其疗效。

sentences.en: It was more about the fact that mentions of this drug were being censored.
sentences.zh: 更多的是关于这款药的提及遭到审查这一事实。

sentences.en: That there was this sort of conspiracy to keep people from learning about ivermectin as a COVID treatment.
sentences.zh: 似乎存在这样一种阴谋，阻止人们了解到伊维菌素可以作为新冠治疗药物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Thank you, Joe.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Sort that out for yourselves, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，你们自己理清头绪吧。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: So that's when the ivermectin frenzy really starts.
sentences.zh: 这就是伊维菌素狂热真正开始的时候。

sentences.en: I mean, the media has censored truth.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，媒体封锁了真相。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because now it's about the media stopping people from learning about a potential cure for COVID so that they instead take the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 因为现在变成了媒体阻止人们了解新冠潜在疗法，好让他们转而去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And that's when you start to have various conservative TV and radio hosts picking up on the narrative as well.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，你会发现各大保守派电视和广播节目主持人也开始炒作这一说法。

sentences.en: It's all coming back to some sort of mind control.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结为某种洗脑。

sentences.en: This really isn't a free country anymore.
sentences.zh: 这真的不再是一个自由的国家了。

sentences.en: You can't even discuss ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 你甚至都不能讨论伊维菌素。

sentences.en: These drugs are being hailed as potential good treatments.
sentences.zh: 这些药物被誉为潜在的良药。

sentences.en: They told us we weren't allowed to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们不准谈论此事。

sentences.en: And then.
sentences.zh: 然后。

sentences.en: The demand for ivermectin is sky high.
sentences.zh: 对伊维菌素的需求呈火箭式飙升。

sentences.en: You have thousands of people across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 全美有成千上万的人

sentences.en: who start to hear about this drug and show up at their doctors or at their pharmacies and just demand ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 开始听说这种药，并出现在医生或药房要求购买伊维菌素。

sentences.en: Prescriptions for the drug increased 24-fold.
sentences.zh: 该药的处方量增加了 24 倍。

sentences.en: And some people take it into their own hands to just get ivermectin in any way possible.
sentences.zh: 有些人则自行采取行动，通过各种可能的方式获取伊维菌素。

sentences.en: Horse dewormer medication with a horse on the label has been flying off the shelves.
sentences.zh: 标签上画着一匹马的马用驱虫药被抢购一空。

sentences.en: That means actually showing up at livestock supply stores and buying the goo version of this drug that's meant for horses.
sentences.zh: 这意味着人们真的去畜牧用品店购买原本专供马匹使用的凝胶状药物。

sentences.en: Nationally, poison control centers have reported skyrocketing calls about symptoms associated with ivermectin toxicity.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的毒物控制中心报告称，关于伊维菌素中毒症状的咨询电话激增。

sentences.en: And in some cases, people are overdosing.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，人们服药过量。

sentences.en: Let me just say very clearly that ivermectin is not a recommended treatment for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 我要非常明确地指出，伊维菌素不是治疗 COVID-19 的推荐疗法。

sentences.en: It is not a recommended drug to prevent COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 它不是预防 COVID-19 的推荐药物。

sentences.en: At this point, there's still no high-quality randomized controlled trial proving that ivermectin works to treat COVID.
sentences.zh: 目前，仍然没有高质量的随机对照试验证明伊维菌素对治疗新冠有效。

sentences.en: And actually, that study out of Cairo from November 2020, it ended up being retracted in July of 2021.
sentences.zh: 事实上，2020 年 11 月那项来自开罗的研究，最终在 2021 年 7 月被撤回。

sentences.en: And it turned out that when people started looking more closely at the data, some of it had been falsified.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，当人们开始更仔细地审查数据时，发现其中一些数据是被伪造的。

sentences.en: There were rows of patients where clearly there had been patient information that was made up or duplicated.
sentences.zh: 有几行患者数据明显是捏造或重复的。

sentences.en: And pretty much the whole study gets debunked.
sentences.zh: 基本上整个研究都被推翻了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So how are doctors feeling about all this?
sentences.zh: 那么医生们对此作何感想？

sentences.en: I think a lot of doctors really felt like they were at a loss.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多医生真的感到无所适从。

sentences.en: Because at this point, they're begging people to take the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 因为在这一点上，他们在恳求人们去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: They have the clinical evidence that shows that the vaccine is effective.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有证明疫苗有效的临床证据。

sentences.en: And instead, some people are refusing to take the vaccine, but they are taking this drug meant for horses that can be, at certain dosages, dangerous for humans,
sentences.zh: 然而，有些人却拒绝接种疫苗，反而去服用这种本该给马用的药物，该药物在特定剂量下对人类是危险的，

sentences.en: that hasn't been shown to work for COVID.
sentences.zh: 而且并未被证明对新冠有效。

sentences.en: So a lot of doctors are feeling like they are just banging their heads against a wall.
sentences.zh: 所以许多医生感觉自己就像在撞南墙一样。

sentences.en: Well, what is the latest on whether this drug has any real effect?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这种药到底有没有实际效果，最新进展如何？

sentences.en: Well, there's two big clinical trials going on in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 目前美国正在进行两项大型临床试验。

sentences.en: right now.
sentences.zh: 其中一项是由美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）开展的。

sentences.en: One of them is through the NIH.
sentences.zh: 他们正在研究除伊维菌素外可能治疗新冠的多种药物。

sentences.en: And they're looking at a number of drugs that might treat COVID in addition to ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们最早在未来几周内就会了解到更多信息，因为如果没有显示出任何效果，这些试验将被叫停。

sentences.en: And we actually might know a little bit more as soon as within the next few weeks, because if there's really no effect that's being shown, those trials are going to be halted.
sentences.zh: 它们也可能会继续推进。

sentences.en: They also might press forward.
sentences.zh: 但这不会告诉我们任何结果，只能说明现在下定论还为时过早。

sentences.en: And that won't really tell us anything except it's still too early to know.
sentences.zh: 那么，为了反方辩论一分钟，因为我确实听过其中一些播客，而且我听到很多人在谈论伊维菌素。

sentences.en: So, just to play devil's advocate for a second, because I do listen to some of these podcasts, and I have heard a lot of people talking about ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 推动伊维菌素热潮的原因之一似乎是，官方在新冠的一些问题上犯过错误。

sentences.en: It seems like one of the things that is motivating this push for ivermectin is that the authorities have been wrong about some things on COVID.
sentences.zh: 或者至少说，他们的建议发生了变化，因为我们对病毒有了更好的了解，比如口罩是否真的有用。

sentences.en: Or at a minimum, their advice has changed because we've come to better understand the virus and whether things like masks actually work.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这种背景下，人们试图自己分析数据似乎并不疯狂，

sentences.en: And so, in that context, I guess it doesn't seem crazy that people would be trying to parse the data themselves,
sentences.zh: 试图研究并找出可以作为替代疗法的方法。

sentences.en: trying to look at the research and figure out what might work as an alternative treatment.
sentences.zh: 我认为这完全合情合理。

sentences.en: I think that's totally fair.
sentences.zh: 我认为围绕伊维菌素的这种情绪，触及了自大流行爆发以来一直存在的一种观点，即很多人觉得自己被欺骗了。

sentences.en: I think that the sentiment around ivermectin is tapping into this idea that's been here since the beginning of the pandemic that a lot of people feel lied to.
sentences.zh: 无论是早期关于不要戴口罩的信息，还是关于停工和重新开放的种种混乱，公众对公共卫生权威机构的信任度严重缺失。

sentences.en: Whether it was that early messaging around not wearing masks or a lot of the confusion over shutdowns and reopenings, there's a real lack of trust in public health authorities.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得他们想转向他们信任的权威来源，无论是乔·罗根、塔克·卡尔森还是劳拉·英格拉姆。

sentences.en: And people feel like they want to turn to the sources of authority that they trust, whether that's Joe Rogan or Tucker Carlson or Laura Ingram.
sentences.zh: 他们想找一个让他们觉得能支持自己的人。

sentences.en: They want to turn to someone who they feel like has their back.
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于，当这种心态开始驱动行为时，可能会变得非常危险。

sentences.en: I think the problem is when that starts driving behaviors, that can really be risky.
sentences.zh: 例如，人们服用专为马匹准备的药物，或者人们只是服用未经批准用于治疗新冠的药物，然后又拒绝接种疫苗，

sentences.en: For example, people taking drugs that are meant for horses or people just taking a drug that's not approved for use in COVID and then refusing the vaccine,
sentences.zh: 而疫苗已被证明有效，许多医生也表示这是我们摆脱危机的唯一出路。

sentences.en: which has been proven and which a lot of doctors are saying is really our only ticket out of the crisis.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 有趣的一点是，医学界的这小块领域已经完全被席卷美国生活的党派极化现象所吞噬。

sentences.en: one of the things that's interesting here is that this little corner of medicine has just become fully engulfed in the partisan polarization that just affects everything in American life.
sentences.zh: 就像有一种民主党人的方式来保护自己免受新冠感染，也有另一种共和党人的方式来保护自己免受新冠感染。

sentences.en: There's like a Democratic way to protect yourself from getting COVID and a Republican way to protect yourself from getting COVID.
sentences.zh: 这种动态似乎吞噬了一切。

sentences.en: And it just seems like this dynamic swallows everything.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为伊维菌素是一个非常鲜明的例子，说明科学是如何陷入文化和政治战争中的，

sentences.en: Yeah, I think ivermectin is a really stark example of how science has gotten caught up in the culture and political wars,
sentences.zh: 人们听到保守派领袖谈论伊维菌素这种药。

sentences.en: where people are hearing conservative figureheads talk about this drug ivermectin.
sentences.zh: 因此他们根本没有兴趣去等待临床试验的结果，因为他们打算走保守派的疗法路线来治愈新冠。

sentences.en: And so they actually have no interest in waiting to see what the clinical trials say, because they're going to go the conservative route to curing COVID.
sentences.zh: 艾玛，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Emma, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯文。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 周五，死于 COVID-19 的美国人总数突破 70 万，超过了 1918 年至 1919 年的流感大流行。

sentences.en: The number of Americans who have died from COVID-19 surpassed 700,000 on Friday, overtaking the influenza pandemic of 1918 and 1919.
sentences.zh: 这使得本次疫情成为美国历史上最致命的大流行。

sentences.en: And making this the deadliest pandemic in American history.
sentences.zh: 自 6 月中旬以来，已有近 10 万美国人死于该病毒，而在这一时期，安全有效的疫苗对美国成年人来说已经广泛普及。

sentences.en: Almost 100,000 Americans have died of the virus since mid-June, a period in which safe, effective vaccines were widely available to American adults.
sentences.zh: 最近的许多死亡病例集中在南部地区，该地区的疫苗接种率落后于全国其他地区。

sentences.en: Many of the recent deaths have been concentrated in the South, a region that has lagged the rest of the country in vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 我们注意到，亨廷顿海滩这里的海滩已经受到了石油污染，石油似乎也渗入了塔尔伯特沼泽。

sentences.en: And we're aware that oil has hit the beach here in Huntington Beach, and it also appears that oil has infiltrated the Talbert Marsh.
sentences.zh: 南加州发生的一起重大漏油事故导致超过 12.6 万加仑的石油流入太平洋，

sentences.en: A major oil spill in Southern California sent more than 126,000 gallons of oil into the Pacific Ocean,
sentences.zh: 杀死了当地的野生动物，并形成了覆盖至少 13 平方英里的油膜。

sentences.en: killing local wildlife and creating an oil slick that covered at least 13 square miles.
sentences.zh: 据当局称，这起由管道破裂引起的漏油事故还影响了亨廷顿海滩附近的受保护湿地塔尔伯特沼泽，

sentences.en: The spill, which authorities said was caused by a ruptured pipeline, also affected the Talbert Marsh, a protected wetland area near Huntington Beach,
sentences.zh: 这里是数十种鸟类的栖息地。

sentences.en: which is home to dozens of species of birds.

sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治、戴夫·肖和丽莎·周剪辑。

sentences.zh: 包含艾丽西亚·拜图普和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。
